To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Block Maturity Level (BML) Consensus protocol is a new consensus protocol which eliminates the 50% attack problem, hardfork problem and the small-scale problem by implementing the sub-blocks in the blockchain.
BML consensus protocol can be a better alternative to PoW and PoS consensus protocols.
BML consensus protocol is the best solution for small-scale implementation of the blockchain and also it is the best solution to eliminate the 51% attacks and hardforks in the blockchain.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the security of blockchain, which can be used in various projects.
the security of the implementation of blockchain, which can be used in any project where the implementation of the consensus protocol is needed.
the implementation of the block maturity level (Bml) consensus protocol on small-scale projects and its comparison with other existing protocols.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the BML is a promising consensus protocol for blockchain implementation on small scale projects.
the block maturity level consensus protocol would be a better option in the implementation of the small scale blockchain projects and would be more secure than the existing consensus protocol.
the block maturity level consensus protocol is the best solution to secure the blockchain on small scale and new implementations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the block maturity level consensus protocol is a consensus protocol that can be used in small-scale implementation of blockchain.
the proposed consensus protocol is a defense mechanism against the 51% attacks, hardforks and the small-scale problem, which can be used in small-scale blockchain implementation.
we have proposed a consensus protocol for the blockchain which would be able to secure the network from the 51% and hardfork attack.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have identified the key challenges in implementing the blockchain in a small scale or in a newly implemented projects.
the BML protocol can be used in small scale projects where the hash power is low and difficulty is easy to match-up and can be used to secure the blockchain against attackers.
we have introduced the block maturity level consensus protocol as a solution for small scale projects and newly implemented blockchains.
